prompt_version: 2.3 (reported configuration; exact console version not recorded)

improvements: History insufficiency is no longer shown to the user.
Speed wording uses the first and last quarter rather than first and second half.
The unsupported physiological-causality explanation is absent.
Distance, duration, average speed and elevation values are mostly understandable to users.
concerns: The model still labels raw speed statistics as stable or low variation without a calibrated classification claim.
The model still labels the terrain as relatively flat from elevation gain and range without a route-classification rule.
The pace dimension references speed feature claims but writes 25 km/h, which requires a display value on feature claims or a separate average-speed claim.
The pace dimension writes a rounded 1.25 m/s while the deterministic claim value is -1.2483215846 m/s; the current numeric validator may reject this rounded token.
Share copy still uses subjective comfort language such as畅快、舒服 without direct intensity or subjective-feeling evidence.
